text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...Just as I thought. The moon tonight is 
so very beautiful..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(The silence of the night, the pale 
moonlight. ...I'm glad I went for a walk.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(...I wonder what they are doing 
underneath this moon...—)

Do you want to 'peek' into the "DPSE" too, 
Still in Love?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Universe-san... Did you come here to 
gaze at the night sky?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. ...You are "observing" the 
moon.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Total agreement." Because that's Still in 
Love's "HOBB."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
To the moon, it's "GRAV", right? ...Is 
that Still in Love's "transmission"?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
C-"Communing"...? No, it's nothing quite 
so grandiose...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I look at the moon... I feel a 
certain warmth. A sense of nostalgia, and 
deep fondness...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
However, um... during a full moon... it 
seems she takes that a bit too far, 
though...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...Still in Love and "MOON." Guided by 
"gravity," indeed.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
So, Neo Universe has a "proposal." Shall 
we "FELT" the universe together?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean... we would be spending the 
night together?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes, indeed. With you by my side, perhaps 
I'll discover a night sky I've never seen 
before...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(...She really is such a mysterious 
person. Gazing up at the night sky as if 
in prayer...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(Still, I think I might understand. 
Beneath this moonlight, I too... want to 
think of that person.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(When did it start? Whenever I look at the 
moon, her face always comes to mind.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(The calmer my heart becomes... the more 
my mind fills with thoughts of her—)

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
You're 'lonely' too, aren't you, Still in 
Love?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Neo Universe and Still in Love becoming 
'crewmates'... surely wasn't a 
'coincidence.'"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "We are searching for 'Earendel.'"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Universe-san and I—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(I wonder why. Even though I don't 
understand the words... it feels like I 
know what they're trying to convey—)

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The "disconnect" between you and Neo 
Universe. If you desire "FSPY"... close 
your eyes.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...L-Like this, perhaps? ...————

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
! ...This place is... It's like being in a 
sea of stars...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Are those the Earth and the Moon...? 
Amazing, they're both so huge...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love's "love" for "MOON." ...It 
"resonates" with me.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
A "severance" of 384,400 km. Yet "E.M.S" 
is not quite the same as "loneliness."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The moonlight becomes a "navigational 
route"... because the two are "connected".

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...We're connected. Even if we're far, far 
apart—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, indeed... I am sure I feel the exact 
same way."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
No matter how thin or tangled the red 
thread on our little finger may be... we 
still wish for it to connect us to "that 
special someone."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...I think I understand somehow. Say, Neo 
Universe—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: You and I truly must be alike.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Is this... the rooftop...? No way, it was 
supposed to be locked...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Look. It's so "sparkly." ..."LUNA" is 
dancing too.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
! I had no idea the moon could look so 
clear from here... ...Fufu. You truly are 
a wondrous person.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking down the hallway, I spotted 
some familiar Umamusume. Curious, I 
watched them, and...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Universe-san. The forecast says clear 
skies tonight... If you'd like, care to 
gaze at the night sky together?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Sphira. If it's "SKC," the Moon can surely 
be "observed" too.
choice_data_list:
Stargazing together, huh? You two must be 
close

If you don't mind, tell me what the moon 
was like.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Universe and I... I am certain we are 
looking at the same thing.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. Still in Love is... a 
"bestie."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's right. Ms. Universe and I are 
friends.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. I shall engrave it deeply upon my 
heart. So that my words will reach 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...CQ, CQ. Someday, 'severance' will be 
filled with 'transmission'—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
It will surely "reach." ...Like 
"moonlight" reaching the "Earth."
